JournalInteraction.title: Journal Interaction
JournalInteraction.description: A turn in the user's private reflection journal (user entry or Pain-Pal reflection).

role.description: The speaker role of this turn.

text.description: The text content of the journal prompt or reflection.

createdAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when this interaction turn was recorded.

modelUsed.description: The Gemini model or safety guard identifier used.

moodEmoji.description: Optional visual emoji representation of the mood.

tags.description: Categorical tags for tracking themes over time.

insight.description: Brief constructive reflection question or takeaway.

safetyRouted.description: Flag set if safety routing layer was activated.

users/{userId}/interactions/{interaction.description: Stores user journal entries and Pain-Pal reflection turns, isolated by Firebase UID.
